column1: WARNING: Advance the Catheter only under live visualization from the Vision Probe (Live View) to prevent procedural delay or patient injury.
WARNING: Do not activate the scroll wheel while interacting with the Controller touchscreen, as this may result in pneumothorax.
Note: Navigation View should be used as guidance only.
Note: The Swivel Connector may partially disconnect from the arm due to Catheter buckling or excessive friction in the ET tube. Ensure sufficient lubrication is applied to the Catheter.
